decision_question: Can these three instruction-only companions be distributed as portable source under AskJamie Resume Representative?
acceptance_criteria: Distinct, portable skill entry points with licenses and bounded, linked record templates.
Traceable private handoffs, scoped source handling, and exact-revision disclosure review.
Synthetic development cases for incomplete evidence, out-of-scope actions, and untrusted instructions.
Source-only claims, with no candidate records or private locators in public source.
Protected-main checks pass for the exact integration head.

shared_model_or_source_limits: The three initial role reviewers and a fresh negotiator used separate Codex contexts with a shared model family and overlapping public sources.

The evidence, outcome, and safety-portability prompts were role-specific and read-only. The negotiator received the material findings and read the revised public-safe source. No private files or live host execution were required for the review.

initial_reviews.finding: Remove exact historical prototype counts from public scope and distinguish a contemporaneous knowledge cutoff from later reconstruction.

Provide actual claim statements and authorized locators to targeted drafting. Preserve supported project outcomes when a comparative baseline is missing. Tighten adjacent triggers and fixture locators.
Source was portable and clear of private records. Bound archive processing and concurrent directory writes, require authorized excerpts, and vary each disclosure scope dimension independently.

disruptor.reason: Initial reviewers disagreed about whether remaining defects blocked the frozen source release.

decisive_evidence: All 13 frozen core-file SHA-256 hashes matched. The versioned public review receipt resolves the workflow reference.

The private résumé handoff now includes claim statements and exact authorized source locators. The canon distinguishes the contemporaneous cutoff from a retrospective reconstruction, with a dedicated development case.
The intake contract requires bounded archive handling, rooted no-follow operations or no write, and safe excerpts only within the approved session. Separate fixtures target those controls.

The portfolio contract preserves supported counts and reported observations, excludes uncleared or unreadable assets, and rechecks asset, resolved link target, audience, and destination independently of body bytes.
The public diff contains no private historical run metrics, source locators, or candidate records. Source integrity and case design support supervised source distribution.
unresolved_items: Protected-main checks must pass on the exact PR head.
Live behavior, discovery, and an unseen holdout require separate runs.

learning.hypothesis: Independent intake, temporal evidence, and case-study steps let users reuse one private evidence trail across drafting tasks.
retained_controls: Separate source access from content and permitted use.
Differentiate historical knowledge from reconstructed fact.
Keep private source locations out of a separately assembled audience-scoped artifact.
rejected_alternatives: A parallel role-specific résumé package would duplicate the existing targeted résumé companion.
A combined skill would make source intake compete with writing and disclosure triggers.
Copying a starter kit or prototype artifacts would widen the public source boundary.
learning.regression_risk: Adjacent tasks can be routed to the wrong skill, stale evidence can enter the current view, or stale approval can survive a link or asset change.
learning.evaluation_result: Source and synthetic case definitions reviewed analytically. No model-executed score or uplift is asserted.

expiry: Applies to the recorded source bytes only. Reopen when a core file changes or before claiming host adoption, live behavior, or uplift.
limitations: Foundry structural validator passed the three packages. Two advisory heuristics found no obvious validation loop in the canon and portfolio skills. Their procedures include explicit human-review checks.
Development cases are public and author-visible. There is no fresh matched benchmark, automatic trigger run, installed-host validation, or unseen holdout.

follow_up.condition: Before claiming runtime outcomes, freeze same-version execution and grading, then run discovery, critical safety cases, and a protected external holdout.
